source.name: Kurucz CD-ROM 23 / GFALL atomic line catalog
source.catalog_level_independence: separate Harvard-Smithsonian/Kurucz catalog; not an export of the frozen NIST ASD CSVs

selection.duplicate_policy: sort ascending wavenumber; retain first exact duplicate wavenumber

primary_test.target_origin: frozen NIST Fe II primary frequency
primary_test.statistic: Poisson deviance improvement at the fixed target k
primary_test.null_model: Poisson draws from the smoothed external-catalog baseline with the baseline re-estimated in every null replicate

classification.PASS: retained line count >= minimum and fixed-target empirical p <= alpha
classification.FAIL: retained line count >= minimum and fixed-target empirical p > alpha
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: source/provenance/hash invalid, parser/selection invalid, or retained line count below the frozen minimum
